expectedOutcome: After completing the plan, learners can recognize 22 core problem families and apply stable solution patterns to common data-structure, graph-search, and dynamic-programming problems.
goal: Build broad interview-topic coverage and a reliable completion rhythm with a focused official roadmap.
notRecommendedFor: There is no data structure at all.
All we need is a single thematic breakthrough.

phases.focus: Start with arrays and strings, practicing two pointers, sliding windows, and prefix sums.
phases.title: Arrays, Two Pointers, and Sliding Windows

phases.focus: Build reliable patterns for hash maps, stack/queue state, and linked-list pointer rewrites.
phases.title: Hashing, Stacks, Queues, and Linked Lists

phases.focus: Practice tree DFS, BFS, and binary search tree properties.
phases.title: Binary Trees and Binary Search Trees

phases.focus: Cover graph search, priority queues, boundary-aware binary search, and basic backtracking.
phases.title: Graphs, Heaps, Binary Search, and Backtracking

phases.focus: Complete the dynamic-programming core through one-dimensional and multidimensional state design, then reinforce bit manipulation.
phases.title: One-Dimensional and Multidimensional Dynamic Programming

phases.focus: Finish the roadmap with tries, intervals, monotonic stacks, and a complete review.
phases.title: Tries, Intervals, and Monotonic Stacks

prerequisites: Understanding the underlying concepts of arrays, chains, trees and maps
recommendedFor: Need short- and medium-term interviews for sprinting.

summary: Complete the official LeetCode 75 roadmap in six weeks, covering 22 core interview topics.
targetAudience: Learners with basic data-structure knowledge who want to complete a high-quality core interview roadmap in one to two months.
